name: Vertical Loom
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop product/docs homepage
Primary request: Design the full first 1.6 viewports of the Agent Factory homepage in the locked Drawcord System visual world. Composition B: Vertical Loom. A sparse navigation leads to a split first viewport: the proposition and install command occupy the left third, while a tall technical loom on the right shows gold cords descending from Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode, passing through specialist agents, human approval, verification loops, and converging into a ready change. Below, two horizontal bands explain Shape Work and Do Work with stitched route diagrams and starter commands. Install sits high in the reading order.
Real content: Agent Factory; From work item to ready change.; Install first; Shape work; Do work; Codex; Claude Code; OpenCode; Human approval; Ready change. Do not invent testimonials, metrics, customers, prices, or capabilities.
Visual system: near-black silk #121317, muted drawcord gold #B79A55, graphite/slate #4A4E57, warm chalk #E5E0D4. Narrow tailored grotesk for labels; readable workhorse sans for body. Gold routing cords, graphite stitching, gathered matte folds, anchor and lock controls.
Composition/framing: straight-on 1536x1024 desktop webpage, no browser chrome; high-fidelity web UI comp. The vertical routing field is information architecture, not decoration. Show enough second fold to prove the system.
Avoid generic AI motifs, robots, brains, chat bubbles, neon, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, glowing nodes, bento grids, literal cape photography, model imagery, and watermarks.
